description:
The quiz evaluates knowledge of advanced semantic HTML5 elements, testing the ability to distinguish and correctly use tags beyond basic <div> and <span>. It is moderate in difficulty, presented with a light‑hearted, encouraging tone that nudges learners to improve their markup skills. The style is informal and motivational, aiming to boost confidence while highlighting gaps.
Topics: HTML5 semantic elements, Proper tag usage, Accessibility considerations, Modern web markup best practices
Audience: Front‑end developers and web designers with basic HTML experience who want to validate and deepen their semantic HTML knowledge.
